summary: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, solely to announce its fiscal second quarter 2027 earnings conference call. The company will report results before market open on November 5, 2026, hosting a call and webcast at 8:00 am ET, with replay available until November 12, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed. The filing is a routine scheduling notice, not a special situation. Risk-arb angle: none; watch quarterly results for operational updates.
